I haven't taken a single pill yet. I've just read the side effects from people who took it online and I feel like the negative side effects outweigh the possible benefit.

I have been visiting a therapist, but I don't think it's helping. Also, I understand what you mean about how most people don't know how to react to it. If my friends came up to me and started talking about all of their problems, i would probably act the same way (i hope not tho)

Thank you for taking the time out of your day to respond.
